strings.applypresetdescription: If you change your mind after applying this preset, you can undo the setting changes via 'Show version history' in the preset actions menu.
strings.author: Author
strings.basedescription: Presets allow you to easily switch between different site admin configurations. After selecting a preset, you can turn on more features any time as required.

Are you sure you want to delete the site admin preset {$a}?

This preset has been previously applied. Deleting a preset removes it from your site completely. You will not be able to revert your settings to how they were before applying this preset.
